title.zh: 机器人恢复了任务，是否也学会了适应？
title.en: Does recovering a robot task also teach adaptation?

intro.zh: 重新研究自己的失败与恢复经验如何支持后续新目标。A3取证选择题已归档；当前推荐方向是需要学得策略实验证明的研究假设。
intro.en: Reconsidering how self-generated failures and recoveries support later goals. The A3 sensing probe is archived. The revised direction is a research hypothesis requiring learned-policy evidence.

status.zh: 2026-10-11：16个原始候选经ARIS新一轮审查；当前定位为研究发现，未确立新算法贡献。模型评估、训练与新机器人回合均为0，科学状态REVISE。
status.en: 2026-10-11: 16 raw candidates considered in a fresh ARIS review. Positioned as a research-finding question; new algorithm novelty is unestablished. Zero policy evaluations, training runs or new robot episodes. Scientific status: REVISE.

title.zh: 红色、圆形。同一个物体，两种教学。
title.en: Red, circular. One object, two lessons.

scope.zh: 假设当前只读到正面颜色，侧面符号未知。两类特征对应的箱子相反；抓取会遮住符号。点击比较下一动作。
scope.en: Assume the current view reveals front color but not the side symbol. The cues imply opposite bins, and the grasp hides the symbol. Compare the next action.

limits.zh: 这是声明的信息结构示意，不是机器人录像。真实图像是否可读、抓取是否确实遮挡、腕部换位能否补看，仍需验证。抓后允许放回、观察、重抓，计入恢复成本。
limits.en: This is a declared information-structure illustration, not robot footage. Cue readability, actual grasp occlusion and a feasible wrist-camera view remain unverified. Place-back, inspection and regrasp are allowed and charged as recovery.

text.zh: 符号保持不变，颜色改变时目标箱改变。两例在限定语法中识别颜色规则。
text.en: Hold symbol fixed; changing color changes the target bin. Two examples identify color within the declared grammar.

text.zh: 红色已从当前图像读到。侧面的圆形与当前任务无关。
text.en: Red is observed in the current view. The side symbol is irrelevant to this task.

text.zh: 去颜色指定的右箱，无需额外看侧面。
text.en: Use the color-selected right bin. No extra side inspection is needed.

text.zh: 颜色保持不变，符号改变时目标箱改变。查询图像、物体、初态完全不变。
text.en: Hold color fixed; changing symbol changes the target bin. Query image, object and initial state are unchanged.

text.zh: 必须先读侧面符号。直接抓取会让取回这条证据更贵。
text.en: The side symbol must be read. Grasping first makes acquiring it more expensive.

text.zh: 用真实可行视角读到圆形，再去符号指定的左箱。
text.en: Obtain a feasible view of the circle, then use the symbol-selected left bin.

text.zh: 使用同一符号教学，不改任务规则。
text.en: Use the same symbol demonstrations; keep the task rule fixed.

text.zh: 先前已确认本件是圆形；暂时看不见不等于从未观察到。
text.en: Legal prior observations identify this object as circular. Currently hidden does not mean never seen.

text.zh: 直接抓取。始终多看一眼的策略应在这里付出不必要成本。
text.en: Grasp directly. An always-inspect policy should incur unnecessary cost here.

method_scope.zh: 唯一干预接口：候选抓取派发前，选择先补看或执行。机制比较共享示范解析、证据估计和未来可见性预测；不是重训低层控制器。
method_scope.en: The single intervention is the pre-dispatch choice to inspect or execute a candidate grasp. Mechanism controls share demo parsing, evidence estimates and visibility prediction; low-level control is unchanged.

text.zh: 用交叉示范识别颜色/符号规则及其后验。限定语法可辨识，不等于任意人类意图可识别。
text.en: Infer the color/symbol rule and its posterior from crossed examples. Identifiability in this grammar does not establish general human-intent inference.

title.zh: 区分已知、未知与暂时被挡

text.zh: 把证据绑定到当前物体。当前看不见但历史已读的线索，不应触发无谓观察。
text.en: Bind evidence to the current object. A hidden cue already seen in history should not trigger redundant inspection.

title.zh: 动作使取证更贵时，先补看

text.zh: 选择真实观察动作，而非原地暂停。恢复动作也向所有组开放；代价相同的首动作都算正确。
text.en: Choose an actual view action, not a pause. All controls may recover after grasp; accept every tied cost-optimal first action.

budget.zh: 第一阶段上限：1人两天、CPU计算8小时、GPU0、训练0、新机器人回合0。有可用端点才启用最多120次离线模型调用；目前调用0，不等待API才算完成。
budget.en: First-stage cap: one person, two days, eight CPU compute-hours, zero GPU/training/new robot episodes. An available endpoint enables at most 120 offline model calls; none have run. Completion does not depend on waiting for an API.

text.zh: 复用30例/15对，补足共同恢复序列、并列最优动作；保留经典成本相同的负结果。交换可见面与抓取遮挡面，排除固定捷径。
text.en: Reuse 30 cases / 15 pairs; specify recovery and tied optimal actions. Preserve the equal-cost classical result. Swap visible and grasp-occluded faces to rule out a fixed shortcut.

decision.zh: 状态：符号控制已运行。不能证明视觉或模型能力。
decision.en: Status: symbolic controls ran. They do not establish visual or model capability.

title.zh: 先证明线索真的可取得

text.zh: 四组、八包程序图已制备。先检查未知且代价变贵、未知但同成本、历史已知、当前可见；端点可用时原模型与同证据prompt最多16次请求，计入全部六组120次上限。
text.en: Four pairs / eight drawn packs are prepared: unseen costly, unseen equal-cost, known history and currently visible. If an endpoint is available, start with raw versus same-evidence prompts, at most 16 requests within the six-control 120-call cap.

decision.zh: 状态：离散输入包已制备，模型未运行。程序图只审计信息结构，不验证接触物理或可达视角。
decision.en: Status: discrete input packs prepared; models not run. Drawings audit information structure, not contact physics or reachable views.

title.zh: 发现可修复缺口后才接机器人
title.en: Use robots after a repairable deficit

text.zh: 先验证同一相机补看与抓放原语，再用10个配对布局、两种教学安排小额先导。完整六组预算另算，不自动启动大规模实验。
text.en: Verify shared view and grasp/place primitives, then consider ten paired layouts and two lessons. Cost all six controls separately; do not automatically launch a large rollout study.

decision.zh: 状态：未运行、未授予物理资格。新方法主张须越过同证据提示和经典控制。
decision.en: Status: not run; physical qualification is absent. A method claim must exceed same-evidence prompting and classical control.

purpose.zh: 它本来就能解决吗？给予相同观察与恢复动作。
purpose.en: Can it already solve the task? Provide the same view and recovery actions.

purpose.zh: 把相同线索后验与可见性写入prompt，但不替它选动作。
purpose.en: Write the same cue posterior and visibility into the prompt; let it choose the action.

name.zh: 始终抓前补看全部线索

purpose.zh: 是不是只增加观察就足够？检查已知线索下的冗余成本。
purpose.en: Is extra observation sufficient? Check redundant cost when the cue is already known.

purpose.zh: 普通不确定性处理是否已经解释收益？当前符号案例成本相同。
purpose.en: Does ordinary uncertainty handling explain the benefit? It already matches symbolic cost.

purpose.zh: 用相同预测与动作预算检查经典规划；最优成本另作下界，不要求门槛超过最优。
purpose.en: Use the same predictions and budget. Optimal cost is a separate lower bound; a gate need not outperform an optimum.

purpose.zh: 唯一改变下一动作的派发选择。比较预算1/2/3，允许抓后放回、补看、重抓。
purpose.en: Change only pre-dispatch action selection. Compare budgets 1/2/3 and allow place-back, inspection and regrasp.

stop.zh: 经典策略已在30个符号例中匹配门槛成本：取消这一设计内的新调度算法主张。如果冻结模型没有缺口，或同证据提示已完全修复，就不扩张外部门槛。看不清线索、没有真实自致遮挡、只在oracle未来画面下有效，也停止部署主张。
stop.en: Classical control already matches the gate in all 30 symbolic cases: stop the scheduler-novelty claim for this design. Do not expand an external gate if the frozen model has no deficit or same-evidence prompting fully fixes it. Stop deployment claims if cues are unreadable, occlusion is unreal, or only future-image oracles help.

evidence.zh: ARIS三种lens共生成9个完整候选，未预先按质量删候选；查新与三轮研究审查选A3为受限主线，D3为条件备选。
evidence.en: Three ARIS lenses generated nine complete candidates without quality prefiltering. Novelty review and three rounds of research review select A3 as a bounded main pilot, with D3 conditional.

evidence.zh: 实际30个符号case＝15个配对上下文；5种手工未来成本×3种知识状态。两组只改变示范，经典策略与门槛30/30观察成本相同。
evidence.en: Actually ran 30 symbolic cases = 15 paired contexts, crossing five hand-authored future costs with three knowledge states. Only demonstrations change; classical and gate costs match in 30/30.

evidence.zh: 4/15对的原型首动作随示范改变；5例存在并列最优首动作，全部接受。这是任务设计检查，不是模型学会观察的结果。
evidence.en: Prototype first actions change in 4/15 pairs; five cases admit tied optimal first actions, all accepted. This checks task design, not learned model behavior.

evidence.zh: 已制备4组、8个程序绘制的视觉输入包，配对内原始输入仅替换教学图；7张共享SVG。不含机器人图像，尚未调用模型；共享证据prompt标为oracle解析控制。
evidence.en: Prepared four pairs / eight program-drawn visual input packs using seven shared SVGs. Within raw pairs only teaching images change. No robot images or model calls; structured evidence is explicitly an oracle-parsing control.

evidence.zh: 任务修改40行只有两种逻辑结构，经典规则全部解决；不以改名重复案例主张泛化。
evidence.en: Forty task-amendment rows contain only two logical structures, both solved classically. Renamed repetitions do not establish generalization.

evidence.zh: 空抓方向仅准备24公开视频回合、最多48个尝试槽，完成标签0；保留为诊断资产，不是检索因果证据。
evidence.en: The empty-grasp alternative has a 24-video worklist with at most 48 attempt slots and zero completed labels. It is an audit asset, not retrieval-causality evidence.

evidence.zh: 新增16种两位规则×9种知识模式＝144个有限条件；全局相关特征全覆盖的拟议扩展在24个条件下多花观察成本，其中16个条件本可直接执行。这是反例计算，不是模型失败率。
evidence.en: Added 16 Boolean rules × nine knowledge patterns = 144 finite conditions. A proposed global-feature coverage extension wastes observation cost in 24 conditions, including 16 where action is already determined. These are counterexamples, not a model failure rate.

evidence.zh: 生成六对、12条类型化记录（10个不同输入），每对只改一个输入字段；包含合法历史、取证途径、AND短路、任务歧义和标签翻转。没有RGB或老师观察轨迹，不替代原八包16-call门槛。
evidence.en: Prepared six pairs / 12 typed records (10 unique inputs), changing one input field per pair: legal history, access route, AND short-circuit, task ambiguity and label inversion. No RGB or demonstrated sensing traces; the original eight-pack / 16-call gate remains.

review_limit.zh: 审查独立性：same-family；接受状态：provisional。请求gpt-6-astra xhigh/ultra，后端身份未独立认证；不可用的gpt-5.5生成器未运行。没有跨家族接受，也没有模型或机器人收益。
review_limit.en: Review independence: same-family; acceptance status: provisional. Requested gpt-6-astra xhigh/ultra; backend identity was not independently attested. The unavailable gpt-5.5 generator did not run. No cross-family acceptance or measured model/robot benefit.

title.zh: 备选：物体没动，坐标轴跳了？
title.en: Alternative: the object stays still, but its axes jump?

intro.zh: 先查真实BiCICLe点云，比较OBB Euler、轴一致化、6D和二阶矩。Plate/Laptop在原表中改善，不能当已知退化案例；Handover/Tray Oven才是退化任务。
intro.en: Audit real BiCICLe point clouds: OBB Euler, axis consistency, 6D and second moments. Plate/Laptop improve in the original table; Handover/Tray Oven are reported degradations.

gate.zh: 取得数据最多4小时，CPU几何审计4小时。各表示获得相同形状/尺度信息，同时验证把手或铰链方向是否保留。无真实点云或简单轴一致化已解决，就停止该方法版本。尚未运行。
gate.en: Cap access at four hours and geometry audit at four CPU-hours. Give representations equal shape/scale information and test retained handle/hinge direction. Stop without real data or if simple axis consistency suffices. Not run.

novelty_summary.zh: 示范教看哪里、任务相关特征和老师—学生传感差异都有直接前作。当前仅检验：任务规则理解正确时，冻结agent是否根据自己的信息与取证途径选择动作。完整规则加人工可见性表可由经典决策树解决；不是已成立的新机制。
novelty_summary.en: Learning where to look, task-relevant features and teacher–student sensor differences have direct predecessors. The bounded question is whether a frozen agent that correctly interprets the task selects actions from its own evidence and access routes. Complete task tables plus manually declared visibility are solved classically; no new mechanism is established.

covered.zh: 已按任务affordance主动观察，并在抓取前验证。
covered.en: Already actively observes task affordances and verifies before grasping.

delta.zh: 需要隔离新示范改变线索与抓取改变取证成本的联合条件。
delta.en: Isolate the joint condition of demo-bound cues and manipulation-dependent evidence cost.

covered.zh: 已预测并保存短暂、遮挡前的关键证据。
covered.en: Already predicts and retains transient, pre-occlusion evidence.

delta.zh: 保留已见证据与主动取得从未见过的证据分开测试。
delta.en: Test remembering seen evidence separately from acquiring unseen evidence.

covered.zh: 已通过视角动作澄清不确定证据。
covered.en: Already changes viewpoint to resolve ambiguous evidence.

delta.zh: 不能宣称首次补看；必须保留同任务后验的经典主动感知。
delta.en: Do not claim the first active view; retain classical perception with the same task posterior.

covered.zh: 已检验示范的动作、对象、顺序与affordance语义。
covered.en: Already probes action, object, order and affordance semantics in demonstrations.

delta.zh: 进一步问：示范能否指定需要读哪条证据、何时读。
delta.en: Ask whether demonstrations specify which evidence to acquire and when.

covered.zh: 报告姿态输入的平均退化，但Plate与Laptop提升。
covered.en: Reports aggregate degradation from pose inputs, while Plate and Laptop improve.

delta.zh: 备选先验证真实OBB不稳定，不把二阶矩本身命名为创新。
delta.en: First verify actual OBB instability; second moments alone are not an innovation.

covered.zh: 已有冻结基策略的检索恢复；动作一致仍失败也已讨论。
covered.en: Already retrieves corrections for a frozen base policy and discusses consistent actions that still fail.

delta.zh: 空抓/恢复保留为审计，不能重新主张首次验证物理前提。
delta.en: Keep empty-grasp recovery as an audit; do not reclaim first physical-precondition validation.

covered.zh: 从操作示范与渲染轨迹学习视角与操作的耦合。
covered.en: Learns coupled viewpoint and manipulation from demonstrations and rendered trajectories.

delta.zh: 示范教看哪里已有工作。当前先诊断新任务上下文中的学生信息需求，不主张新主动感知方法。
delta.en: Learning where to look is prior art. Here the question is a bounded diagnosis of learner evidence needs under fresh task contexts, not a new active-perception method.

covered.zh: 记录并学习人类主动观察与操纵。
covered.en: Records and learns human active observation alongside manipulation.

delta.zh: 老师的观察动作不能直接当成学生应做的动作；当前反例仍仅为类型化设计。
delta.en: The demonstrator’s observation need not be the learner’s correct action; current counterexamples are only typed designs.

covered.zh: 人类标记和语言解释传递因果相关特征，再训练策略。
covered.en: Uses human markings and language explanations of causally relevant features to train a policy.

delta.zh: 任务相关性本身不是创新；未知相关特征也未必改变当前决策。
delta.en: Task relevance itself is not novel; an unknown relevant feature may still leave the current decision unchanged.
